xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1674: TLDR .venv is duplicated into every workspace

plan.title: TLDR .venv (~7.5G) is duplicated into every workspace — 236G across 33 worktrees, caused disk-full ENOSPC
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Workspace creation copies the project-root TLDR venv (1.5G since PAN-3534; ~7.5G when filed) into every worktree with `cp -a`, or pip-installs a fresh one per workspace when the root has none. 20 live workspaces hold ~30G of identical copies; at 33 worktrees with GPU torch this filled the disk and ENOSPC zero-filled ~/.claude.json.
narratives.Proposal: Make each workspace .venv a symlink to <projectRoot>/.venv (every consumer reads join(ws,'.venv') and follows links; the daemon keeps state in <ws>/.tldr). Never build venvs during workspace creation; add `pan admin tldr install` to build the root venv once and `pan admin tldr dedupe` to convert legacy copies. Hide the symlink from git via the common-dir info/exclude and Overdeck's .gitignore. Skip Python-project workspaces. Refuse workspace creation below a 10 GiB free-disk floor, exclude .venv from the stash-clean backup, delete the now-unused relocateVenvScripts, and update docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A machine-level venv under ~/.overdeck/ shared across projects
- Building the TLDR venv automatically during workspace creation
- TLDR support for Python-project workspaces (workspace root with pyproject.toml/requirements.txt/Pipfile/setup.py)
- Wiring the reclaim route's venv janitor (cachedVenvCandidates) or any HTTP route or UI for dedupe
- Sharing or deduplicating the per-workspace .tldr/ index
- Changing the Deacon disk-pressure patrol or its BuildKit prune
- Running dedupe automatically
- Editing any other project's tracked .gitignore

autoDecisions.summary: Link target is the project-root venv <projectRoot>/.venv, not a machine-level venv
autoDecisions.rationale: It already exists and every other consumer (pan up, main daemon, merge-agent) uses it; a ~/.overdeck venv adds a second location and would build in /tmp under a polluted OVERDECK_HOME.

autoDecisions.summary: Workspace creation never builds a venv; `pan admin tldr install` builds the root venv once
autoDecisions.rationale: On-demand building needs a cross-process lock, ready marker and crash recovery because workspaces are created concurrently; an explicit install removes that surface. Projects without a root venv run workspaces without TLDR until the operator installs once.

autoDecisions.summary: Workspaces with a Python-project marker skip the shared link
autoDecisions.rationale: A uv sync/pip install in one workspace would otherwise write into the venv every workspace shares.

autoDecisions.summary: Hide the link via common-dir info/exclude (git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude), plus `.venv` in Overdeck's own .gitignore
autoDecisions.rationale: Planning verified `.venv/` does not ignore a symlink; create-perform.ts precedent forbids editing a project's tracked .gitignore.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse (not warn) workspace creation below 10 GiB free, reusing the disk-pressure patrol's floor value
autoDecisions.rationale: ENOSPC mid-write zero-fills files (the incident corrupted ~/.claude.json); one floor value is simpler to explain.

autoDecisions.summary: Dedupe is a CLI subcommand only
autoDecisions.rationale: A new HTTP route requires a no-loss-matrix row and UI; the operator runs it once.
The current project-path lookup only finds the patch when the project is Overdeck; scripts/ ships in package.json files.

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-1674.md W6. New src/lib/workspace-manager/tldr-venv-dedupe.ts exporting DedupeEntry {workspacePath, bytes, action: 'converted'|'would-convert'|'skipped', reason?} and dedupeWorkspaceVenvs(projectRoot, {dryRun}, deps?). Throw when <root>/.venv/bin/tldr is missing. For each <root>/workspaces/feature-*: lstat <ws>/.venv; skip silently when missing or a symlink; skip with reason when a real dir lacks bin/tldr or the workspace has a Python-project marker; measure bytes with async `du -sb`. Dry run -> 'would-convert'. Otherwise stop daemon (errors ignored) -> rename to <ws>/.venv.pan-1674-old -> linkWorkspaceTldrVenv -> ensureVenvExcluded -> Node rm of the old dir (recursive, force) -> start daemon (errors ignored) -> 'converted'; on link failure rename back and record 'skipped'. CLI: add `dedupe` case + help line, `--dry-run` option in admin/index.ts, description 'TLDR daemon: status, start, stop, warm, install, dedupe'; print one line per entry and a 'Reclaimed <X> GiB from <N> workspaces' ('Would reclaim' in dry run) total; --json prints entries. Never shell out to rm with a variable.

Refuse workspace creation below the 10 GiB disk safety floor

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-1674.md W7. New leaf src/lib/disk-floor.ts (imports only node:fs/promises): DISK_SAFETY_FLOOR_BYTES = 10 * 1024 ** 3, readAvailableBytes(path) = statfs bavail*bsize, checkDiskFloor(path, read = readAvailableBytes) returning the error text 'Only <X.X> GiB free on the filesystem holding <path>; workspace creation needs at least 10.0 GiB. Free disk space (see /resources) and retry.' or null; a reader failure returns null. In createWorkspace, right after the dryRun early return and before the workspace row is created, call checkDiskFloor(projectConfig.path) and on error set success=false, push the error, return. Do not edit disk-pressure-patrol.ts.
